P1.1.text: Industrial Technology Company - Crane NXT, Co.

P1.2.text: As a premier industrial technology company, CraneNXT provides advanced technologies and services to customers throughout the world.

P1.3.text: Providing trusted technology solutions to secure, detect, and authenticate what matters most

P1.4.text: Our deep expertise, propriety technologies and aftermarket services help our customers protect their most important assets and ensure secure, seamless transactions.

P1.5.text: Our growth is driven by our focus on continuous improvement, investing in our core business, and expanding our portfolio through value-enhancing acquisitions.

P1.6.text: It all starts with our team. We believe that attracting passionate people, excited and energized about our mission and giving them the ability to achieve their goals is the key to success.

P2.2.text: A foundation built on more than 200 years of innovation

P2.3.text: But the spirit of entrepreneurship and innovation that drives our business traces its origin to the early 1800s. While much has changed in nearly two hundred years, our unique ability to evolve and innovate remains our key advantage.

P2.4.text: Crane NXT was by the separation of Crane Holdings Company into two separate companies: Crane NXT and Crane Company.

P2.5.text: Our unique technologies deliver advanced solutions to secure, detect, and authenticate our customers’ most important assets. We are focused on driving growth through continued investment in our businesses and solving our customers most important challenges.

P2.6.text: At Crane NXT, we continue to follow the high standards set for the company over 150 years ago.

P2.7.text: Doing great things requires great people.

P2.8.text: We give people confidence every day in moments that matter.

P2.9.text: How we work is just as critical as what we do. Discover how we drive innovation and continuous improvement.

P2.10.text: We believe that teamwork and shared values are the key to our success.

P3.2.text: Industry leading technologies and services to secure, detect and authenticate what matters most to our customers.

P3.3.text: Our patented micro-optic technology protects the world’s most valuable brands from counterfeiters and fraud, ensuring that consumers get the authenticity they deserve, every time. We are the world’s leading micro-optic producer wielding powerful in-house software and a mastery of specialized materials and equipment to generate the most secure and engaging visual effects. We have created a family of features that are differentiated by ease of use and incomparably resilient against simulation and counterfeiting.

P3.4.text: Our state-of-the-art detection and sensing technologies ensure the highest level of security and authentication for our customers’ most critical applications. Our advanced image recognition software analyzes over 5 million data points in more than 1,000 dimensions while simultaneously referencing 20 proprietary algorithms. The result is a best-in-class technology platform that delivers the highest level of security to our customers. Coupled with our integration and assembly expertise, as well as a vast in-house service network, we are uniquely qualified to deliver one of the industry’s most comprehensive systems offerings.

P3.5.text: Our cloud-based architecture is configured to give our customers seamless access to their devices – enabling real-time machine management and performance alerts. With our comprehensive management platform, our customers benefit from remote diagnostics, payment transaction data, live machine monitoring, consumer analytics, and the potential for added revenue streams from our proprietary in-house advertising network.

P3.6.text: Consumers want fast, flexible solutions that keep them moving. Our customers want smart automation that enables their employees to perform on high-value work. At CPI, we want it all. Explore the integrated technologies that keep our markets moving.

P3.7.text: As a partner to businesses and governments, Crane Authentication offers expertise and cutting-edge innovations that protect and enhance products, secure identities, safeguard revenues and enforce compliance.

P3.8.text: Crane Currency is a fully integrated supplier of secure, durable and beautifully designed banknotes for central banks
